entities.name: Nesimi Çimen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nesimi Çimen was a Turkish folk singer and poet. He was killed, along with 34 others, during the Sivas massacre in Sivas, Turkey when a group of Islamist rioters set fire to the hotel where the victims had gathered for the Pir Sultan Abdal festival.
